description: This file contains a unit test class for the WorkShiftService within the OrangeHRM system. It tests the functionality of saving, retrieving a list, and fetching a WorkShift by ID, using mock objects and test data.

classes.name: WorkShiftServiceTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing the WorkShiftService functionalities such as saving and retrieving work shift data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case with a new instance of WorkShiftService and loads fixture data.

methods.name: testSaveWorkShift
methods.description: Tests the saving of a WorkShift object using a mocked DAO.

methods.name: testGetAllWorkShifts
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of WorkShift entities.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific WorkShift by ID.
